prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Gustavo, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Gustavo trusts the staff who run the municipal pool.
Change to make: CHANGE THE SOURCE: say the claim comes from a different, more convincing source (for example someone who works at the council).
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "Has anyone heard anything about the pool possibly having water issues? I’m not sure if there’s any truth to it, but it might be worth keeping an eye on."
text: I just spoke with a contact at the city council who confirmed there might be some water issues at the pool. It’s probably worth keeping an eye on, though I’m sure the staff will handle it.
